newsitem.title: USA: Dollar Tree Q1 sales, same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Dollar Tree Q1 sales, same-store sales up.

text.p: Dollar Tree Stores Inc said on Wednesday that its sales for the first quarter increased $32.7 million to $117.7 million from $85.0 million in last year's first quarter.
Last year's first quarter sales are exclusive of January sales at the Dollar Bills stores, which were acquired on January 31, 1996.

Comparable store sales increased 10.9 percent for the first quarter of 1997 over the first quarter of 1996, Dollar Tree said. Comparable store sales include a full quarter for both Dollar Tree and Dollar Bills comparable stores, it said.
